pattern_rationale: The system drops periodic flat CSV files (rx_export_*.csv) on a nightly schedule into a designated runtime directory. The file_drop_ingest pattern ingests these files and de-duplicates re-exported records across daily drops.

alternatives_considered.why_not: The source system provides flat file exports rather than exposing an HTTP API.
No direct database connection or read-only SQL interface is available.
The system emits periodic batch file drops instead of real-time event messages.

sync.detail: Nightly polling of directory specified in config['path'] for rx_export_*.csv files

field_map.transform: Pass through string representation of MRN
Pass through RxNorm code as string
Pass through DRUG_DESC text as display string
Parse integer string to numeric JSON value
Parse date in DD/MM/YYYY format and emit ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD string

risks: Re-processed or out-of-order export files may overwrite newer prescription states if file ordering does not strictly follow timestamp sequence.
Data parsing failures if START_DT contains malformed date strings or non-standard formats.
human_review_points: Verify whether local status code 'C' should map to 'completed' or 'cancelled'.
Confirm whether nightly export files represent cumulative extracts or incremental updates.
